scripts.emulators: npm --prefix functions run build && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS= firebase emulators:start --import=./.firebase/emulator-data --export-on-exit=./.firebase/emulator-data
scripts.emulators:fresh: npm --prefix functions run build && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS= firebase emulators:start
scripts.test:functions: npm --prefix functions run build && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS= firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions --project demo-attn "node tests/functions/staff-callables.smoke.mjs && node tests/functions/staff-invites.smoke.mjs && node tests/functions/member-passwords.smoke.mjs && node tests/functions/member-recovery.smoke.mjs"
scripts.test:rules: cross-env NODE_OPTIONS= firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-attn "node --test tests/rules/*.test.mjs"
